title: The Office — three real agents walk in and work

beats.text: A small intranet repo was just prepared on this machine. I'll dispatch three agents to it — each one becomes a character in the office.

beats.label: inventory
beats.instruction: List the files with ls, read README.md, then create INVENTORY.md at repo root listing every file you found, one per line.

beats.label: treasure hunt
beats.instruction: Use grep to find which file mentions the word 'quasar', then create FOUND.md at repo root with the file path and the matching line.

beats.label: doc writer
beats.instruction: Read the files under docs/, then create DOCS-SUMMARY.md at repo root with a 3-line summary of the internal guides.

beats.text: All three are working — watch the labels on the characters: those are the real commands they're running.
Done. Notice: the work happened in a task-owned clone — your real repo was never touched. That's writeScope.
